dragHint: Drag to move the panel · edges and corners to resize
dragSection: Drag to reorder · click the name to collapse
notAvailable: Not available in this game version.
maxTip: Raise to this job's max level
addTip: Uses the game's own function: applies the trait's bonuses and removes opposites
traitNote: Adding/removing a trait also adds/subtracts its skill bonuses. Opposite traits are removed automatically.
propNote: The limit depends on your class and stewardship. Above 1.2× the limit the game may make you lose properties (theft, disease).
modNote: Multiplies with the game's own. For "Expenses" use a factor below 1 (e.g. 0.5 = half the expenses).
legend: ★ = includes a trainer factor. Green = in your favor.
achShownTip: Only affects the achievements visible with the current filter
achNote: Removing an achievement only removes it in the game: it can't be removed on Steam.
stackMinusTip: Remove one copy (with 1 copy, removes the trait)
stackNote: Each extra copy adds 10% more of the skill bonus. Health, fertility and revenue don't change with copies (that's how the game calculates them). Children inherit the copies.
warAdvisorToggle: Show advice next to the game's military events
warLegend: ★ = recommended option: lowest risk of death first, then highest chance of a crown, fewer injuries and more prestige and influence. If an option leads to another window, it assumes you then pick the recommended one. Figures are expected values, already scaled by your revenue and class.
warAdvisorFoot: ★ = recommended (also highlighted in the game). Expected values, already scaled by your revenue and class. 🎲 Force picks that option with the shown result; any achievements it gives unlock as in the game (Steam too).
warEndsWar: brings the end of the war forward
grassNote: Chances depend on your character's skills (combat, eloquence, intelligence) and on having the Strong trait. The game gives the Corona Obsidionalis trait.
triumphNote: Winning the crown later triggers the triumphal procession (Triumphator), with very large rewards.
achSteamTip: When you tick an achievement, or add with the trainer a trait that has an achievement (crowns, injuries, Veteran, Pedigreed…), it is also unlocked on Steam. Steam achievements cannot be removed.
achSyncTip: Unlocks on Steam every achievement marked as obtained in the game
achConfirmSteam: Mark {n} achievements and also unlock them on Steam? This cannot be undone on Steam.
achConfirmSync: Unlock the {n} obtained achievements on Steam? The ones you already have on Steam won't change. This cannot be undone.
steam_noSteam: Steam is not available: achievements are only marked in the game.
steam_apiOff: Steam achievements are disabled in the game's settings: they are only marked in the game.
steam_mode: This game uses easy mode, sandbox or mods: the game doesn't allow Steam achievements.
xNote: What the game's example mods do, from the trainer. Mod mode stays off: game and Steam achievements stay enabled.
xDarkModeTip: Turns the game's dark mode on or off (the same setting as in Settings)
xThemeNote: Green, Mono Mix and Vestalia come from Prahlad's "theme" mod; the rest are the trainer's. They are readable with or without dark mode. The trainer remembers the chosen theme.
xPlayAsConfirm: Switch to playing as {name}? Their household becomes yours.
xPlayAsNote: Take control of any other living character, in or outside the household. Your current character stays in the game.
xDivorceConfirm:
Divorce {a} from {b}?
Cost: {cost}.
This cannot be undone.
xAdoptConfirm:
Give {name} up for adoption? They leave the family for good.
Cost: {cost}.
This cannot be undone.
xAdoptNote: Up to age 15, unmarried, and not studying or away. As in the mod, the game records it as a death: the funeral window appears.
xDynastyConfirm: Found the {name} dynasty? You and your descendants who carry your family name join it, with the same prestige.
xDynastyNote: Creates a new branch for you and your descendants; the rest of the family keeps its name. (The original mod renamed the whole dynasty.)
scn_caesar_info: Start as the father of Julius Caesar, who is about 8 years old on this date.
scn_agrippa_info: Start as Marcus Agrippa: general, statesman and architect, friend, son-in-law and right hand of Augustus, the first emperor.
scn_antony_info: Start as Julia, mother of the triumvir Mark Antony, right after her husband's execution.
xScenarioConfirm:
Play the "{name}" scenario?
The date moves to year {year}, its family becomes yours, and money, influence and properties are set to the scenario's. Your current family stays in the game but is no longer your household.
Save to another slot first: this cannot be undone.
xScenarioNote: Scenarios from the official "Play a Scenario" mod. If your game is past the scenario's year, the date goes back.
xAttica: Agrippa: your wedding to Attica, daughter of Atticus (gens Pomponia), is near. You may refuse, but it will mark your and your family's honor.
xNotEnough: Careful: you don't have enough money and will go into the negative (the game has debt events).
xInGameNote: Adds the mods' buttons to the game's interface: on each character (Play as, Divorce, Give for adoption), on the main screen (Argentarius, Theme, New dynasty, Scenarios) and in the "Arrange Betrothal" window (Matchmaker). They open game windows. Without the trainer connected, the buttons are hidden.
xAdoptMsg: You can find a suitable family to adopt {name}, and once they're adopted, their well-being will no longer be your concern.
xThemeMsg: Choose the game's colors. They are readable with or without dark mode.
xDarkModeToggle: Turn dark mode on or off
xDynastyMsg: Split away from the age-old name and move on to a more fitting one for your family? You and your descendants who carry your family name join the new dynasty, with the same prestige.
xScenarioMsg: Play as one of these families? The date, money, influence and properties become the scenario's, and your current family is no longer your household. Save to another slot first: this cannot be undone.
xAtticaYesTip: This will be a feast to remember.
xMmMatrilineal: Matrilineal marriage: the spouse joins your household.
xMmNote: Based on peritiSumus' "Coemptio" mod. It is in the game's "Arrange Betrothal" window: the rings button, next to "Pay to look for other matches". You pay her fee (5% of your money, at least 20,000) plus an extra per candidate for what you ask for: more candidates, heritage, minimum skills, traits and "no bad traits". The game creates the candidates (with dowry and personality), they are fitted to your order and appear first in the list; you marry from there, as usual. Like the game's, they are dropped after 6 months or when you pay for other matches. The ones still available are listed below.
xMmOrderMsg: The matchmaker will look for candidates for {name}. Her fee is fixed; each thing you ask for costs extra per candidate. Choose what you want and pay to have them added to the list.
finHubMsg: The argentarius will see you. Your class: {cls}. The bank lends to you at {rate} a year, up to {limit}.
finHubDebt: You owe {debt} at {rate}: this year you will pay {interest} in interest.
finBorrowMsg: Interest: {rate} a year (lower with your eloquence). Limit: {limit} (higher with your stewardship). You can borrow up to {room}. Interest is charged every year in Martius.
finRepayMsg: You owe {debt}. What you pay ahead now carries no interest.
finLendMsg: These families are asking for money. You can lend up to {room} in total.
finLendNone: Nobody is asking for money this month.
finSkillsLend: The more interest you charge, the more likely they won't pay; your stewardship lowers that and your combat helps you recover a bad debt.
finLendRateMsg: The {family} family asks for {amount} for {years} year(s). At what yearly interest?
finSharesMsg: Buy shares (partes) in state contracts. You can invest up to {room}; purchase fee: {fee}.
finAtWar: Rome is at war: supplying the army pays more, but it is riskier.
finProxyNote: As a senator you invest through a front man: he keeps {commission} of what you earn, and each year there is a {scandal} risk of scandal.
finSkillsShares: Your stewardship raises dividends, your intelligence lowers risk and your eloquence improves prices.
finBuyMsg: You can invest up to {room}. Purchase fee: {fee} (lower with your eloquence).
finSellMsg: They sell at {factor} of their value (higher with your eloquence).
finSeaMsg: Lend to a merchant for a voyage: if the ship arrives you collect capital and interest; if it sinks, you lose the loan. You can lend up to {room}.
finWinter: It is winter: the sea is "closed" and the risk of shipwreck doubles.
finSkillsSea: Your intelligence picks better routes (less risk) and your stewardship raises the limit.
finSeaAmountMsg: You can lend up to {room}. Spreading it over many ships, as Cato did, pays less but you almost never lose everything.
finSailTip: All or nothing: it arrives or it sinks
finSailPoolTip: You collect according to how many ships arrive
finPfEmpty: You have no debts or investments.
finSeaOk: The ship from {route} arrived: you collected {amount}
finSeaLost: The ship to {route} sank: you lost {amount}
finSeaPool: Voyage to {route}: {ok} of {n} ships arrived, you collected {amount}
finScandal: Scandal! It came out that you invested through a front man: you lose {prestige} prestige and {influence} influence
finBillMsg: Martius has come: you owe {debt} at {rate} and must pay at least the interest ({interest}). Will you pay more?
finDebtSlave: You cannot do this while in debt bondage.
finNote: Roman banking and investments. Borrowing: every class (interest from 12% for the Proletarii down to 8⅓% for Equites and Senatores). Lending to families and publican companies: from Class I. Maritime loans: from Class III. Senatores invest through a front man. Your character's attributes have no cap: 20 is neutral, below it they penalize (15 → ×0.70; 10 → ×0.42) and above it they help. Stewardship = higher amounts, more of what you collect and fewer defaults; eloquence = less interest and better prices; intelligence = less risk; combat = you recover more from bad debts. Results arrive in Martius and when ships return.
finOpenTip: Opens the argentarius window in the game
finPanelSkills: Stew {stew} · Elo {elo} · Int {int} · Com {com} — 20 is neutral; less penalizes, more improves with no cap
